trustClaim.label: K3-TB trusted-boundary
trustClaim.summary: K3-TB trusted-boundary only; not fully formal K3 and not proven equivalent to Lean 4.

tierDefinitions.trusted: TCB-adjacent code. Must stay small, dependency-limited, and independent from execution/plugin/product layers.
tierDefinitions.language: Canonical PSC-1 source language, elaboration, checked standard-library, and environment path.
tierDefinitions.execution: Runtime/backend code that executes already-checked Core artifacts; it must not validate proofs.
tierDefinitions.product: CLI, project, editor, diagnostics, and formatter layers built around the canonical language path.
tierDefinitions.plugin-infra: Plugin API and host infrastructure outside the trusted kernel boundary.
tierDefinitions.bridge: Lean/oracle/unified bridge packages used for correspondence, migration, or optional integration.
tierDefinitions.experimental: Future architecture, prototypes, or feature reservoirs. Not part of the canonical PSC-1 trust claim until promoted.

featurePromotionGate: Add or update parser tests when syntax changes.
Elaborate into checked Core or checked bootstrap declarations before backend/runtime execution.
Add a kernel obligation entry when a feature changes trusted rules.
Add JS execution smoke and TypeScript compile smoke for executable features.
Add theorem/rfl smoke when reduction should be definitional.
Add fail-closed negative tests for unsupported or unsafe forms.
Update the reference-governance matrix and this classification manifest if package boundaries change.
